svg.text: One account. Many transactions. No queue.
EIP-7702 keeps your address · ERC-4337 gives you parallel nonce lanes · live on Sei EntryPoint v0.8
THE PROBLEM: one account is one queue
one gap freezes everything behind it
Sei's Autobahn mempool rejects a nonce gap outright with `bad nonce`,
and Sei documents the pending nonce as unreliable, so there is no
queue you can trust. Hence the usual fleet of funded hot wallets.
THE FIX: one funded account, many independent lanes
same address · same balance · same approvals
each burns its OWN sequential nonce,
one tx in flight → the queue moved HERE
msg.sender at the venue is still
the funded EOA, not a proxy.
THE RESULT: a failure lands alone
all four in the SAME bundle, in the SAME block
Why they cannot block each other
The EntryPoint keeps one seq counter PER key.
A new key starts at seq 0 at any time.
So an op that reverts, or never lands at all,
advances only its own lane. Nothing waits.
the trading key never entered a queue
forge test · 12 passing, including "a dropped op strands nothing behind it"
Independent nonces remove the submission bottleneck. Disjoint state is what buys parallel execution.
